}}'''The Truth and Island Kahuna Hapu''' (Japanese: '''誕生！！しまクイーンハプウ！''' ''Birth!! {{tt|Island Queen|Island Kahuna}} {{tt|Hāpuʻu|Hapu}}!'') is the 22nd chapter of the {{MangaArc|Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga.

==Plot==
{{spoilers}}
{{Incomplete plot}}
==Major events==
* After defeating {{p|Crabominable}}, [[Hapu]] receives a [[Sparkling Stone]] from {{p|Tapu Fini}}, officially making her the next [[island kahuna]] of [[Poni Island]].
* {{adv|Sun}} gives Tapu Fini a [[Mirage Berry]].
* [[Professor Kukui]], [[Molayne]], [[Acerola]], [[Sophocles]], and [[Gladion]] fight {{p|Guzzlord}} to prevent it from reaching [[Hokulani Observatory]].
* In order to protect [[Lillie]], Gladion's {{p|Type: Null}} evolves into a {{TP|Gladion|Silvally}} and defeats Guzzlord.
* Gladion and Lillie reveal that they're siblings and the children of [[Lusamine]].
* Lillie reveals she is in possession of the [[Sun Flute]].
* Gladion and Lillie decide to go to the [[Poni Altar]].
* [[Faba]] and a group of {{tc|Aether Foundation Employee}}s head to [[Vast Poni Canyon]].
{{Adventuresevents}}
{{endspoilers}}
